verdict.rationale: Firecrawl exposes a well-documented public REST API plus official SDKs (Python, Ruby, etc.) covering scrape/crawl/extract/search/parse, with webhooks for async workflows and API key/IP security controls, all backed by extensive docs (203+ pages). This directly enables AI-native users to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s) and independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness beyond docs.
